detail.title: Investigating the Neurodiversity Paradigm vs. Clinical Pathology Models
detail.summary: Continued project work on the foundations of the neurodiversity paradigm. A review of the available project evidence identified a misalignment; existing bibliographic sources do not adequately address the comparative conceptualization of neurodiversity versus clinical pathology models. New research is queued to identify foundational literature.

children.title: neurodiversity paradigm vs medical model clinical pathology conceptualization

detail.reason: Existing evidence lacks direct, high-quality sources comparing the neurodiversity paradigm with clinical pathology models; this search aims to secure appropriate foundational literature to support a substantive notebook.
